blocks.title: DevOps
blocks.text: DevOps tareeqon ka majmooa hai jo software development (Dev) aur IT operations (Ops) ko jorta hai ta ke software products aur khidmat dene mein mil jul kar kaam, kaarkardagi aur phurti barhe (Fig. 1.6). Is ka bunyadi maqsad development lifecycle chhota karna, software ka maiyar behtar karna aur zyada aitbar ke saath musalsal delivery dena hai.

items: Behtar mil jul kar kaam: development aur operations teams mein ta'awun ka mahaul alag khanon (silos) ko tor kar unhein mushtarka maqasid par lata hai.
Market tak jaldi pohanch: continuous integration aur continuous delivery (CI/CD) ki khudkari updates aur nayi features jaldi deti hai.
Behtar maiyar: musalsal testing aur nigrani masail jaldi pakar kar theek karti hai.
Zyada kaarkardagi: dohrae jane wale kaamon ki khudkari haath ki mehnat aur insani ghalti kam karti hai.

blocks.text: DevOps web aur mobile apps aur cloud services ke liye behtareen hai jahan tez development aur barhna zaroori hai; maslan Amazon ka e-commerce platform DevOps se nayi features aur updates musalsal jaari karta hai. Yeh sakht qawaneen ya hardware par munhasir projects ke liye kam munasib ho sakta hai; maslan tibbi aalaat (medical devices) ke software ko sakht testing aur qawaneen ki paasdari chahiye jo DevOps ki tez raftar se mel na khaye.

blocks.prompt: In mein se kaunsa DevOps ka faida nahi: behtar ta'awun, behtar maiyar, project ke daire ka be-qaboo phailao (scope creep), market tak jaldi pohanch (MCQ 6)?
blocks.explanation: Project scope creep ka izafa, option (c): scope creep, project ke daire ka be-qaboo phailao, masla hai faida nahi. Kitab ki answer key (b) deti hai jo text mein faida ke taur par likha hai.

items: DevOps: development aur IT operations ka mel; chhota lifecycle, behtar maiyar, musalsal delivery (Fig. 1.6).
Fawaid: ta'awun, jaldi market (CI/CD), maiyar, kaarkardagi; web, mobile aur cloud (Amazon) ke liye munasib, qawaneen ya hardware wale projects ke liye kam.
